explanation: The theorem says that a function in the principal series of GL3 over a local field (defined in this library) is right-invariant under an open neighbourhood of 1. Its proof uses library-specific lemmas: the Iwasawa/word decomposition, the compactness of the word-inverse set, and local constancy. Mathlib has no principal series, no LocalGL3, and no matching lemma on smooth vectors. I did not run searches of the Mathlib sources; this answer rests on my knowledge that Mathlib has no such representation-theory material. The only general fact used is that a locally constant function is invariant under an open neighbourhood on a compact set. That is a step inside the proof and not the full result.
